name: adversarial
description: Stress cases beyond the happy path. Each targets a specific failure mode: paraphrased-topic reversal (judge must match topics worded differently), multi-valued accumulation (must NOT supersede), re-confirmation (must NOT register a false reversal), and subject isolation (one person's reversal must not touch another's facts).
